variants.name: Plainspoken — second person, sentence case
variants.essence: The HUD talks to you in calm plain English — the current de-facto voice completed into one consistent set, with the caught-up affirmation the PLAN seeded: "You're all caught up · Nothing needs you right now."
variants.spec:
PRINCIPLE: every string answers "what does this mean for me?" in second person, sentence case, em-dash guidance, GitHub's own nouns only. Honesty device: the FRESH/DEGRADED copy split — present tense + "right now" is permitted ONLY when Freshness == .fresh; degraded readings switch to as-of phrasing and the caution banner composes above.

CAUGHT-UP EXPANDED (rows empty AND pulse empty, hasData true): body renders a centered affirmation block replacing the empty body. Layout: island 520×~124px (16px top pad + 16px header row + 8px + block + 8px + 14px footer + 16px bottom pad); block = two lines, text-align center, full width minus 18px side pads; line 1 "You're all caught up" 13px/500 #E6EDF3; 3px gap; line 2 fresh: "Nothing needs you right now" 11px/400 #7D8590; block vertical padding 18px. DEGRADED: line 2 becomes "Nothing needed you as of {FreshnessModel.ageText} ago" and the existing caution banner (11px/500 #D29922, clock.badge.exclamationmark 11pt) renders in the header stack, unchanged. MOTION: none of its own — the block appears with the island rebuild on expand (user action); motion budget 0ms, no fade, no pulse (attention-non-theft).

RADAR-EMPTY WITH PRs: no new row (the per-lane placeholder stays banned); the header title slot carries the state — "githud" → "All caught up" (11px/600 #7D8590, same slot as "Needs you", IslandContentView.swift:258). Degraded: "All caught up" stays, banner carries the doubt.

FULL STRING SET — header: "Needs you" / "All caught up" (was "githud"); lanes: "Your PRs", "Stale", "Drafts"; stale caption: "3 stale · untouched 14d+" (unchanged); freshness banner: "Updated 8m ago" / "Reconnecting — last update 8m ago" (unchanged); footer: "GitHub inbox ↗", a11y "Open your GitHub inbox".
PILL VOICEOVER: loading "githud — checking GitHub"; radar "1 needs you"/"3 need you"; critical suffix ", including a security alert" (names the one reserved critical instead of the vaguer "critical alert"); gauge "2 ready, 1 blocked" / "3 waiting"; clear "You're all caught up"; degraded prefix "Reading may be stale — updated 8m ago. ".
AUTH CARDS (360px, keep status codes for debuggability): no-token/welcome heading "Connect GitHub" + steps "1. Create a classic token (ghp_…) with the notifications scope" / "2. Paste it here — it stays in your Keychain, nowhere else" / "3. That's it — githud checks your inbox about once a minute" + link "Create token ↗"; 401: "GitHub rejected the token (401) — it's expired or was revoked. Create a fresh classic token (notifications scope) and paste it again."; 403: "GitHub refused the token (403). If your org uses SSO, authorize the token for it — or add the notifications scope. Then paste it again."; wrong-shape: "That's not a classic token — it should start with ghp_. Fine-grained and App tokens can't read notifications. Create a classic token (notifications scope) instead."; keychain: "Couldn't save to your Keychain — nothing was stored. Try again."
GEAR MENU: unchanged ("Surface…", "Surface which reasons:", "Your PRs:", "Show draft PRs", "Show stale PRs (untouched 14d+)", "Theme", "Hide island"/"Show island", "Quit githud"); tooltips unchanged.
variants.doctrine_fit: Honesty constraint satisfied structurally: "right now" is freshness-gated and degraded copy shifts to as-of + banner — a reassurance can never mask a degraded reading. Zero new motion, zero new color (affirmation is ink), footer audit untouched. ~90% of shipped strings are already this voice, so the copy system ratifies rather than rewrites — smallest possible diff on trust-critical surfaces (auth, banner).
variants.risks: "Nothing needs you" is a strong negative claim whose truth is the classifier's recall — a miss makes this line the lie (mitigated only by the footer audit). The centered block introduces a second alignment register into an otherwise leading-aligned island. Second person can drift cute in future strings without a written style rule.

variants.name: Instrument readout — no pronouns, readings not sentences
variants.essence: githud is a gauge: every string is a reading in the rows' own "noun · count · age" grammar, so copy is structurally incapable of sugarcoating — caught-up reads "Inbox clear · 0 need action."
variants.spec:
PRINCIPLE: no pronouns, no sentences where a reading suffices; the " · " separator the rows already use (RadarPresenter.displaySubtitle) becomes the universal grammar. Meaning lives in data words (counts, ages, states); tone is the absence of tone. Honesty device: readings state what was measured, never how to feel — degraded readings append "· as of {age} ago".

CAUGHT-UP EXPANDED (both lanes empty): leading-aligned (matches every other line — no new register). Layout: same frame as variant 1 (520 wide, 16/18 pads); block padding 8px 0; line 1 "Inbox clear" 13px/500 #E6EDF3; 3px gap; line 2 fresh: "0 need action" 11px/400 #7D8590 tabular-nums; DEGRADED line 2: "0 needed action · as of 8m ago" + caution banner unchanged. Motion 0ms.

RADAR-EMPTY WITH PRs: header slot "githud" → "Inbox clear" (11px/600 #7D8590).

FULL STRING SET — header (radar non-empty): "Action needed" (thesis without the pronoun) + count badge; lanes: "Your PRs" → "Open PRs", "Stale", "Drafts"; stale caption: "3 stale · 14d+ untouched"; freshness banner: stale "last update 8m ago", failing "reconnecting · last update 8m ago"; footer: "full inbox ↗", a11y "Open full GitHub inbox".
PILL VOICEOVER (kept as full phrases — raw readouts are hostile speech): loading "githud, first check running"; radar "3 items need action"/"1 item needs action"; critical "3 items need action, 1 security alert"; gauge "2 ready, 1 blocked" / "3 waiting"; clear "inbox clear"; degraded prefix "reading stale, last update 8m ago. ".
AUTH CARDS — line 1 the reading, line 2 the fix: no-token/welcome: "No token. githud reads the GitHub inbox with a classic PAT (notifications scope), stored in Keychain." steps "1 · Create classic token (ghp_…) — notifications scope" / "2 · Paste — stored in Keychain only" / "3 · First reading within a minute" + "Create token ↗"; 401: "Token rejected (401) — expired or revoked. Fix: fresh classic token, notifications scope."; 403: "Token refused (403) — SSO unauthorized or notifications scope missing. Fix: authorize for the org, or add the scope."; wrong-shape: "Not a classic token (needs ghp_ prefix) — fine-grained and App tokens can't read notifications. Fix: classic token, notifications scope."; keychain: "Keychain write failed — nothing stored. Try again."
GEAR MENU: "Surface…" → "Surface", header "Surface reasons:", "Open PRs:", "Show drafts", "Show stale (14d+)", "Theme", "Hide island"/"Show island", "Quit githud".
variants.doctrine_fit: The strongest structural guarantee of the honesty constraint: a grammar of readings cannot soften a degraded state into reassurance — there is no register for reassurance at all. Unifies the whole product on the separator grammar the rows already speak (one voice, literally). Natural fit for the monotone/Geist a11y direction: meaning survives gray-swap because meaning was never in warmth.
variants.risks: Directly in tension with the PLAN brief's ask that caught-up read "affirming, not blank" — "Inbox clear · 0 need action" is honest but cold, and the empty island stays emotionally empty. Dropping the pronoun in "Open PRs" loses the fact that explains the lane (these are YOURS). VoiceOver needs deliberate exceptions (specced) or it turns curt; that duality is itself a second voice.
variants.mock_notes: Same island/pill/card shell numbers as voice-plainspoken (520px/14px radius/#0D1117/#30363D hairline/16-18px pads; pill 36h/r14; cards 360w). Differences: affirmation block leading-aligned, padding 8px 0; all counts/ages in font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; lane header "Open PRs" 11px/600 #7D8590; banner text lowercase "last update 8m ago" in #D29922; footer "full inbox ↗" 11px #484F58. Render one extra comparison panel: the same PR row subtitle ("acme/api #142 · CI failing · conflicts · 2h") directly above the caught-up block, to show the shared " · " grammar — that adjacency is this variant's whole argument. Auth cards: two-line structure, line 1 12px #E6EDF3, "Fix:" line 12px #7D8590. Tab-switched states; 120ms user-triggered fade max, cubic-bezier(0.33,1,0.68,1).

variants.name: Question, answered — copy as the answer to the thesis
variants.essence: Every string is the answer to INTENT's one question — "does GitHub need me right now?" — caught-up is the answer spoken plainly ("Nothing needs you"), and honesty rides tense: degraded readings answer in the past ("Nothing needed you").
variants.spec:
PRINCIPLE: the product is one question (INTENT.md H1); every surface either answers it, states confidence in the answer, or explains why it can't answer. Honesty devices: (a) TENSE — present tense only under .fresh; degraded flips to past ("needed") with the banner carrying the age; (b) the footer becomes the explicit audit invitation (consult 004's reveal-suppressed test, in copy).

CAUGHT-UP EXPANDED (both lanes empty): leading-aligned sentence block, padding 12px 0; line 1 fresh "Nothing needs you" 13px/500 #E6EDF3; 3px gap; line 2 "Inbox clear · no open PRs" 11px #7D8590. DEGRADED: line 1 "Nothing needed you" (past tense), line 2 unchanged, caution banner above header unchanged ("Showing a reading from 8m ago"). Motion 0ms.

RADAR-EMPTY WITH PRs: header slot "githud" → "Nothing needs you" (11px/600 #7D8590; degraded → "Nothing needed you"), then the "Your PRs" lane as today.

FULL STRING SET — header (radar non-empty): "Needs you" (it IS the answer — unchanged); lanes "Your PRs", "Stale", "Drafts"; stale caption "3 stale · untouched 14d+"; freshness banner: stale "Showing a reading from 8m ago", failing "Reconnecting — showing a reading from 8m ago"; footer: "Check for yourself — GitHub inbox ↗", a11y "Audit the full GitHub inbox".
PILL VOICEOVER: loading "Not answered yet — first check running"; radar "GitHub needs you — 3 items"/"— 1 item"; critical "GitHub needs you — 3 items, one security alert"; gauge "Nothing needs you. 2 ready, 1 blocked" / "…3 waiting"; clear "Nothing needs you"; degraded prefix "Answer may be stale — from 8m ago. ".
AUTH CARDS — framed as can't-answer: no-token/welcome heading "githud answers one question: does GitHub need you right now?" + "It needs a token to ask." steps "1. Create a classic token — notifications scope" / "2. Paste it — it lives in your Keychain and never leaves this Mac" / "3. First answer within a minute" + "Create token ↗"; 401: "Can't ask GitHub — it rejected the token (401): expired or revoked. Create a fresh classic token (notifications scope)."; 403: "Can't ask GitHub — it refused the token (403). Authorize it for your org's SSO, or add the notifications scope."; wrong-shape: "Can't use this token — it isn't classic (ghp_…). The notifications inbox only answers to classic tokens; create one with the notifications scope."; keychain: "Couldn't keep the token — the Keychain write failed, nothing was stored. Try again."
GEAR MENU: unchanged from today.
variants.doctrine_fit: Copy literally implements the ratified thesis sentence ("does GitHub need me right now?", INTENT.md:98-101) — maximum coherence between product theory and product language. The tense rule is a genuinely doctrinaire honesty mechanism: a degraded reading grammatically cannot claim the present. The rewritten footer strengthens the trust experiment's in-product audit (IslandContentView.swift:100-102, 394-396).
variants.risks: "Nothing needs you" is the boldest recall bet of the three voices — it stakes the sentence on the classifier every render. The tense shift is subtle enough that many users will never consciously notice it (the banner still does the real work — the tense is defensible but not load-bearing). "Can't ask GitHub" anthropomorphizes; held loosely it stays calm, but future strings could drift twee. Footer copy is longer (measure: must not wrap at 484px inner width — it won't at 11px, ~180px rendered).
variants.mock_notes: Same shell numbers (island 520/r14/#0D1117/0.5px #30363D/16-18 pads; pill 36h r14; cards 360w; fonts 13/500 #E6EDF3, 11px #7D8590/#484F58, banner #D29922). Distinctive states to mock: (1) fresh caught-up vs degraded caught-up side-by-side — the ONLY diff being needed→needed tense + banner, so the reviewer can judge whether the tense device is perceptible; (2) the footer "Check for yourself — GitHub inbox ↗" vs today's "GitHub inbox ↗"; (3) the welcome card with the thesis heading — set the heading 13px/600 #E6EDF3, body 12px #E6EDF3, steps ol 12px with 4px gaps, link 12px #2F81F7 (accent-as-chrome, a link affordance, not status). VoiceOver values captioned under pills in 10px italic #484F58. Tab-switched panels, user-triggered 120ms fade max cubic-bezier(0.33,1,0.68,1), zero ambient motion.

recommendation.why: It is the voice ~90% of shipped strings already speak, so ratifying it turns scattered de-facto copy into a system with near-zero churn on trust-critical surfaces (auth, banner, VoiceOver), and its fresh/degraded split ("right now" only under .fresh, as-of phrasing when degraded) satisfies the honesty constraint without inventing subtle mechanisms. It is also the only variant that delivers the PLAN's seeded affirmation ("You're all caught up · nothing needs you") warm enough to read affirming rather than blank. If the human session wants more thesis purity, borrow question-answered's footer ("Check for yourself — GitHub inbox ↗") into plainspoken — the two compose cleanly.

verdicts.reason: Breaks its OWN honesty device on the trust-critical line. The spec rules 'present tense + right now permitted ONLY when Freshness == .fresh', then keeps degraded line 1 as present-tense 'You're all caught up'. This is not hypothetical: the cold-launch snapshot paint is ALWAYS .stale (FreshnessModel.forSnapshot, Freshness.swift:53-57), so every launch would greet the user with a present-tense all-clear the data cannot back — if a review request landed overnight, the headline is false at the moment it renders (INTENT: never fabricate a state; a banner + as-of line 2 hedging a false headline is softening, not honesty). Everything else verified clean: 0ms motion, affirmation is ink-only, hasData gate is real (PollReducer.swift:41-45 — lastKey nil→[] renders, so the block can't appear pre-first-poll), degraded age plumbing exists (Freshness carries ageSeconds when degraded, so 'as of {ageText} ago' is buildable with no new plumbing), 'Nothing needs you right now' makes no PR claim so an unfetched pulse can't make it lie, gray-swap trivial. The centered second alignment register and cuteness drift are declared risks, not doctrine breaches. Mock nit: the height math says ~124px but the specced paddings sum to ~141px (16+16+8+(18+13+3+11+18)+8+14+16).
verdicts.amendment: Under ANY degraded freshness the affirmation's line 1 must also leave the present tense — e.g. render the block as one as-of line, 'All caught up as of {FreshnessModel.ageText} ago' (13px/500 ink), with the caution banner unchanged; 'You're all caught up' + 'right now' render only under .fresh. Same rule for the radar-empty-with-PRs header slot: degraded → 'Caught up as of {age} ago' (or keep today's 'githud'), not a bare present-tense 'All caught up'.

verdicts.reason: The doctrine-cleanest of the three, and its claims are all backed by existing plumbing. Every caught-up string is a radar-count reading ('Inbox clear · 0 need action') that only renders after a confirmed first poll (PollReducer.swift:41-45); it makes no PR-existence claim an empty-but-never-fetched pulse could falsify; the degraded form appends '· as of {age} ago' exactly as its own honesty device requires (age is carried by the degraded Freshness cases — no new plumbing). Zero new motion (0ms), zero new color (banner stays the sanctioned caution; footer/affirmation ink), no hover-primary, gray-swap trivial (meaning is in words and counts). The VoiceOver full-phrase exception is explicitly specced and matches the shipped presenter's register (PillAccessibilityPresenter.swift already speaks phrases), so it is a deliberate a11y accommodation, not an accidental second voice. Its one real problem — 'honest but cold' fails the PLAN's 'affirming, not blank' ask, and 'Open PRs' drops the ownership fact — is a design-brief preference, not an INTENT/PRESSURE clause, and the variant declares it honestly. A doctrine review has no grounds to kill or amend it.

Fabricates a state the view cannot back. Caught-up line 2 'Inbox clear · no open PRs' claims PR-nonexistence from an empty pulse array — but an empty array is indistinguishable from a never-succeeded pulse fetch, and pre-first-success the pulse deliberately contributes .fresh to the freshness fold (PollReducer.swift:362-365: lastPulseSuccessAt == nil → .fresh, 'don't accuse before the first success'), so NO banner or tense shift would hedge it. Concrete failure: radar polls fine and is empty while the GraphQL pulse fails persistently → a user with 16 open PRs reads a fresh, unhedged 'no open PRs'. The record's own honesty-mechanics section concedes the view lacks this plumbing (HUDPanelController.swift:296-299 passes only freshness + rows). Second, smaller fabrication: the welcome step 'it lives in your Keychain and never leaves this Mac' is false — the token leaves the Mac in the Authorization header to api.github.com on every poll; on a trust-moat product that overclaim is exactly the kind of line the doctrine exists to catch. The tense device itself is genuinely doctrinaire (degraded L1 'Nothing needed you' — this variant, unlike plainspoken, applies its device consistently), motion 0ms, footer/link colors are ink/accent-as-chrome (sanctioned), gray-swap fine.
verdicts.amendment: (1) Drop the PR claim: caught-up line 2 becomes just 'Inbox clear' — 'no open PRs' may only render if new plumbing (a pulse-has-succeeded flag reaching the view) gates it. (2) Welcome step 2 → 'it's stored only in your Keychain and sent only to GitHub' (or equivalent) — never 'never leaves this Mac'.

review.overall_note: Verification: every file:line claim in current_state checked against source and accurate (header flip IslandContentView.swift:258; no-placeholder :46-49; pill glyph stack CollapsedPillView.swift:75-123; VO values PillAccessibilityPresenter.swift:30-57; banner labels Freshness.swift:82-99; snapshot-always-stale :53-57; auth copy AppDelegate.swift:114/214/242/245/248; 401/403 classify PollReducer.swift:392-393; gear menu StatusItemController.swift:67-175; geometry/theme numbers all match). Two inventory gaps the human session should own since D-copy claims EVERY string: (a) 'Launch at Login' (StatusItemController.swift:86) is missing from the inventory and from all three variants' gear-menu sets; (b) the gear tooltip 'Surface, Theme, Quit' (IslandContentView.swift:275) now undersells a menu that also contains Launch at Login and Hide/Show island — it's a string that lies by omission. Cross-variant defect (fix once, applies to all three): all variants narrow today's 401 copy 'invalid or expired' to 'expired or revoked', but classify() only sees the status code — a never-valid ghp_-shaped paste also 401s; keep 'invalid' in the 401 line. Variant 1's VO suffix 'including a security alert' is backed today (SignalClassifier.criticalReasons == [\"security_alert\"], SignalClassifier.swift:64) but hard-couples copy to that set's cardinality — add a test tripwire if adopted. Plumbing fact that constrains all copy: degraded Freshness carries ageSeconds, so every 'as of {age} ago' degraded string is buildable now; any FRESH-state 'checked Xs ago' (and any 'no open PRs') is NOT — needs new plumbing, exactly as the record says. On the recommendation: voice-plainspoken is defensible ONLY with its amendment applied (degraded line 1 must leave the present tense); as written, the strictly doctrine-safest pick is voice-instrument — the recommendation should say 'plainspoken-as-amended, else instrument', and its suggested footer borrow from question-answered composes cleanly and is doctrine-clean (ink, strengthens the consult-004 audit).
